info.name: AML API OAuth Assets Wallet Analyses API

items.docs: Given a subject address, analysis type of type "wallet_exposure" and an optional customer_reference, perform the requested analysis and return the result

params.name: min_outflow_usd
params.description: minimum outflow USD value

params.name: max_outflow_usd
params.description: maximum outflow USD value

params.name: min_inflow_usd
params.description: minimum inflow USD value

params.name: max_inflow_usd
params.description: maximum inflow USD value

params.name: analysed_at_before
params.description: only return wallet analyses that has been analysed before the given time (ISO8601 datetime)

params.name: analysed_at_after
params.description: only return wallet analyses that has been analysed after the given time (ISO8601 datetime)

params.name: customer_reference_contains
params.description: only return wallet analyses whose customer reference contains the given string

params.name: address_hash_contains
params.description: filter wallet analyses whose address contains the given string

params.name: customer_reference
params.description: only return wallet analyses whose customer reference equals the given string

params.name: workflow_status
params.description: only return analyses whose workflow status matches any of the given values. Accepts a single value or an array of values.

params.name: address_hash
params.description: filter wallet analyses whose address equals the given string

params.name: entity_name_contains
params.description: filter wallet analyses whose name contains the given string

params.name: entity_category_contains
params.description: filter wallet analyses whose category contains the given string

params.name: min_risk_score
params.description: minimum risk score

params.name: max_risk_score
params.description: maximum risk score

params.name: min_risk_score_change
params.description: minimum risk score change since last screening

params.name: max_risk_score_change
params.description: maximum risk score change since last screening

params.name: coverage
params.description: return the wallet analyses for a certain coverage level

params.name: process_status
params.description: return rows that are in any of the states specified in the array. Each element is one of (running, complete, error).

params.name: asset
params.description: return only wallet analyses that has been made on a particular asset or asset/blockchain combination

params.name: risk_rules
params.description: return wallets that has triggered at least one of the specified risk_rules. To get wallet analyses that have not triggered any rules, include empty string in your query. e.g. "?risk_rules=,f7c36274-ba55-4f6b-8d46-d8cbe97d7c32"

params.name: analysed_by
params.description: the ID of the actor who ran the query

params.name: customer_id
params.description: the ID of the customer this wallet analysis is linked to

params.name: assigned_team_user_id
params.description: return wallets that are assigned to the given team user ID(s). To get wallet analyses that are unassigned, include an empty string in your query. Multiple IDs can be provided as a comma-separated list.

params.name: screening_source
params.description: Indicates whether the screening was done via the Synchronous endpoint, Asynchronous endpoint, as part of the Automatic Rescreening feature or as a fallback system rescreening in case of error

params.name: sort
params.description: sort by criterion

params.name: page
params.description: pagination page number

params.name: per_page
params.description: pagination per page number, has a maximum value of 500.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results that are counted. If more analyses than this number are present then this number is returned. This improves the performance of queries over large datasets

items.docs: Paginate through all analyses, with various sort/filter parameters.
Performs a batch of analyses (the max batch size is 100). Responses will contain IDs of the newly created analysis.

params.name: wallet_analysis_id
params.description: id of the wallet analysis to retrieve

params.name: includeScreenings
params.description: toggle whether to include the screening history

params.name: previousScreenings
params.description: Number of previous screenings to include in the response, where the default is 10

items.docs: Given an ID, return a single wallet analysis

info.name: Get a screening of the wallet by ID

params.name: wallet_analysis_id
params.description: id of the wallet analysis to retrieve

params.name: screening_id
params.description: id of the screening to retrieve

items.docs: Given a screening ID, return the screening of the wallet
